rows.label: TRACTION
rows.clue: The friction between a body and the surface on which it moves (as between an automobile tire and the road)

rows.label: HAZE
rows.clue: Atmospheric moisture or dust or smoke that causes reduced visibility

rows.label: BETA WAVE
rows.clue: The normal brainwave in the encephalogram of a person who is awake and alert

rows.label: FLAKE
rows.clue: A crystal of snow

rows.label: SNOW MIST
rows.clue: Small crystals of ice

rows.label: RUBBING
rows.clue: The resistance encountered when one body is moved in contact with another

rows.label: GUST
rows.clue: A strong current of air

rows.label: HEAD SEA
rows.clue: A sea in which the waves are running directly against the course of the ship

rows.label: HEAT
rows.clue: A form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature

rows.label: BREEZE
rows.clue: A slight wind (usually refreshing)

rows.label: LOW BEAM
rows.clue: The beam of a car's headlights that provides illumination for a short distance

rows.label: WAKE
rows.clue: The consequences of an event (especially a catastrophic event)

rows.label: MONSOON
rows.clue: A seasonal wind in southern Asia

rows.label: DRIZZLE
rows.clue: Very light rain

rows.label: FLOOD
rows.clue: The rising of a body of water and its overflowing onto normally dry land

rows.label: WIND
rows.clue: Air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure

rows.label: OFFSHOOT
rows.clue: A natural consequence of development

rows.label: ELVES
rows.clue: An acronym for emissions of light and very low frequency perturbations due to electromagnetic pulse sources

rows.label: WESTERLY
rows.clue: The winds from the west that occur in the temperate zones of the Earth

rows.label: MOON RAY
rows.clue: A ray of moonlight

rows.label: MOCK SUN
rows.clue: A bright spot on the parhelic circle

rows.label: DRAG
rows.clue: The phenomenon of resistance to motion through a fluid

rows.label: DENT
rows.clue: An appreciable consequence (especially a lessening)

rows.label: STRAIN
rows.clue: (physics) deformation of a physical body under the action of applied forces

rows.label: MIRAGE
rows.clue: An optical illusion in which atmospheric refraction by a layer of hot air distorts or inverts reflections of distant objects

rows.label: TORQUE
rows.clue: A twisting force

rows.label: STREAMER
rows.clue: Light that streams

rows.label: CURRENT
rows.clue: A flow of electricity through a conductor

rows.label: WEST WIND
rows.clue: Wind that blows from west to east

rows.label: ALPHA RAY
rows.clue: The radiation of alpha particles during radioactive decay

rows.label: RAIN
rows.clue: Water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere

rows.label: PRESSURE
rows.clue: The force applied to a unit area of surface

rows.label: GRAVITY
rows.clue: (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe

rows.label: AIR HOLE
rows.clue: A local region of low pressure or descending air that causes a plane to lose height suddenly

rows.label: GLOWING
rows.clue: The amount of electromagnetic radiation leaving or arriving at a point on a surface

rows.label: WEATHER
rows.clue: The atmospheric conditions that comprise the state of the atmosphere in terms of temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation

rows.label: VOLTAGE
rows.clue: The rate at which energy is drawn from a source that produces a flow of electricity in a circuit

rows.label: CHOP
rows.clue: The irregular motion of waves (usually caused by wind blowing in a direction opposite to the tide)

rows.label: BOLT
rows.clue: A discharge of lightning accompanied by thunder

rows.label: THRUST
rows.clue: The force used in pushing

rows.label: SKY GLOW
rows.clue: Illumination of the night sky in urban areas

rows.label: PUFF
rows.clue: A short light gust of air

rows.label: DRIFT
rows.clue: A force that moves something along

rows.label: SHEAR
rows.clue: (physics) a deformation of an object in which parallel planes remain parallel but are shifted in a direction parallel to themselves

rows.label: EAST WIND
rows.clue: A wind from the east

rows.label: SUNLIGHT
rows.clue: The rays of the sun

rows.label: FLUKE
rows.clue: A stroke of luck

rows.label: BOND
rows.clue: An electrical force linking atoms

rows.label: EFFECT
rows.clue: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon

rows.label: HAIL
rows.clue: Precipitation of ice pellets when there are strong rising air currents

rows.label: NEAR GALE
rows.clue: Wind moving 32-38 knots

rows.label: RED SHIFT
rows.clue: (astronomy) a shift in the spectra of very distant galaxies toward longer wavelengths (toward the red end of the spectrum)

rows.label: HIGH BEAM
rows.clue: The beam of a car's headlights that provides distant illumination

rows.label: FUME
rows.clue: A cloud of fine particles suspended in a gas

rows.label: HEAT RAY
rows.clue: A ray that produces a thermal effect

rows.label: AFFINITY
rows.clue: (immunology) the attraction between an antigen and an antibody

rows.label: ION BEAM
rows.clue: A beam of ions moving in the same direction at the same speed

rows.label: AEROSOL
rows.clue: A cloud of solid or liquid particles in a gas

rows.label: BETA RAY
rows.clue: Radiation of beta particles during radioactive decay

rows.label: LONG WAVE
rows.clue: A radio wave with a wavelength longer than a kilometer (a frequency below 300 kilohertz)

rows.label: EXCHANGE
rows.clue: Chemical process in which one atom or ion or group changes places with another

rows.label: HIGH WIND
rows.clue: A very strong wind

rows.label: RAY
rows.clue: A column of light (as from a beacon)

rows.label: MISHAP
rows.clue: An unpredictable outcome that is unfortunate

rows.label: LIGHT AIR
rows.clue: Wind moving 1-3 knots

rows.label: GALE
rows.clue: A strong wind moving 45-90 knots

rows.label: FOG
rows.clue: Droplets of water vapor suspended in the air near the ground

rows.label: GAMMA RAY
rows.clue: Electromagnetic radiation emitted during radioactive decay and having an extremely short wavelength

rows.label: SKY WAVE
rows.clue: A radio wave that is reflected back to earth by the ionosphere or a communications satellite

rows.label: SUCTION
rows.clue: A force over an area produced by a pressure difference

rows.label: DEPOSIT
rows.clue: The phenomenon of sediment or gravel accumulating

rows.label: CALM AIR
rows.clue: Wind moving at less than 1 knot

rows.label: SNOW
rows.clue: Precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals

rows.label: HEAT WAVE
rows.clue: A wave of unusually hot weather

rows.label: SPECTRUM
rows.clue: An ordered array of the components of an emission or wave

rows.label: ENERGY
rows.clue: (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work

rows.label: FORTUNE
rows.clue: An unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another

rows.label: WALLOP
rows.clue: A forceful consequence

rows.label: LEVERAGE
rows.clue: The mechanical advantage gained by being in a position to use a lever

rows.label: ARC
rows.clue: Electrical conduction through a gas in an applied electric field

rows.label: LIGHT
rows.clue: (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation

rows.label: SLEET
rows.clue: Partially melted snow (or a mixture of rain and snow)

rows.label: MIST
rows.clue: A thin fog with condensation near the ground

rows.label: SPRINKLE
rows.clue: A light shower that falls in some locations and not others nearby

rows.label: ICE FOG
rows.clue: A dense winter fog containing ice particles

rows.label: CLOUD
rows.clue: Any collection of particles (e.g., smoke or dust) or gases that is visible

rows.label: THERMAL
rows.clue: Rising current of warm air

rows.label: BLUE JET
rows.clue: Atmospheric discharges (lasting 10 msec) bursting from the tops of giant storm clouds in blue cones that widen as they flash upward

rows.label: GREENING
rows.clue: The phenomenon of vitality and freshness being restored

rows.label: COLD WAVE
rows.clue: A wave of unusually cold weather
